subject: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation, retention footprint & capacity growth
messages:
From: Samir Kale <samir.kale@brightpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tina Zhou <tina.zhou@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal scope questions

Ben —

Thanks for the heads up about the upcoming renewal. BrightPay is preparing for our SOC 2 re-attestation and we want to make sure the renewal terms reflect the new retention and evidence footprint we discussed in the last call. A few quick items from our security and legal teams: 

- Can Redwood confirm the default audit-log retention by customer tier and whether we can carve out a 3rd-party escrow for logs (we may need a split custody approach).
- We plan to expand usage ~25% over the next 12 months — can that be covered under an expanded Dedicated capacity addendum, or should we shift to a 24-month term for better pricing?
- We’ll upload a preliminary evidence index. Attached: SOC2-evidence-inventory.xlsx and a draft retention map (retention-map-v2.pdf).

Also looping Tina from Acme Legal for the standard MAA redlines — she had follow-ups last quarter.

Appreciate any quick guidance so we can align procurement timelines.

—Samir
Security Lead, BrightPay

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-inventory.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), retention-map-v2.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kale <samir.kale@brightpay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal scope questions

Samir — thanks for the detailed packet and the retention map. Welcome Tina. 

Quick answers up front: 
- Default log retention by tier: Hosted API: 30 days (ingest index), Dedicated: configurable 90/180/365d options; Private: customer-managed. We can provision a custody split for audit logs (we’ve done a signed escrow arrangement for two customers this year). I’ve asked Marissa to outline the evidence handoff sequence for SOC 2 recert.
- Capacity: we can cover a ~25% usage increase by adding a Dedicated burst band and scheduling a cap increase; if you’re comfortable with a 24-month term we can apply a 12% committed-use discount and include a retention tier at the Dedicated plan level. I’ll have Connor draft an onramp schedule.

I’ve attached the latest MAA template (MAA_v2.docx) and will send a DocuSign quote once legal confirms the term/discount preference. Proposed next step: 30-minute sync Wednesday to lock the sequence (evidence sprint -> DocuSign -> procurement). Does 10am PT work?

Cheers,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAA_v2.docx (docx stub)
From: Tina Zhou <tina.zhou@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Samir Kale <samir.kale@brightpay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal scope questions

Thanks Ben — 10am PT Wednesday works for procurement review. A couple of notes from legal on the MAA redline we saw: 

- We need explicit language about audit-log ownership when escrow is used; please add a clause that defines retrieval windows and responsibilities for preservation and chain-of-custody.
- Retention tiers need to be surfaced in the SOW (we prefer hard numbers rather than toggles).
- Can you provide the HubSpot deal id/quote link so legal can reference the pricing in the redline?

We’ll prepare a short redline and flag anything that requires SOW changes.

—Tina
Senior Counsel, Acme Corp.
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kale <samir.kale@brightpay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

I’ll post the HS deal link here once the quote is generated. If we agree on 24-month term I propose we include a 12% committed discount and add a line to the SOW for a 365d retention tier option at a fixed per-seat surcharge.

—Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tina Zhou <tina.zhou@acme.com>, Samir Kale <samir.kale@brightpay.com>

Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal scope questions

Folks — following our sync this morning, summary and next steps: 

1) SOW retention tiers to be explicitly listed: 90 days (default Dedicated), 180 days (optional), 365 days (premium add-on). We will include exact retrieval SLA language for escrow (48–72 hours depending on region).
2) Capacity path: Phase 1 (T+30): +15% Dedicated buffer; Phase 2 (T+90): additional +10% to reach ~25% uplift. Connor will share the cost delta and slot reservation table by EOD.
3) Term/discount: BrightPay elected 24-month term with 12% committed discount. DocuSign quote generated and attached (DocuSign-quote-1123.pdf).
4) Evidence runbook: Redwood will open a Drive folder (link below) and accept the SOC2-evidence-inventory.xlsx upload. We recommended a 2-week evidence sprint cadence with weekly check-ins.

Next actions and owners: 
- Marissa to post final SOW retention language and escrow clause (by 2026-11-03).
- Connor to publish phase cost table and onramp schedule (by 2026-11-01 end of day).
- Ben to route DocuSign to procurement after Tina confirms redline (imminent).

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-id-retention-map
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-98765

Thanks — I’ll follow up on the SOW draft and attach the final MAA with the included retention buckets.

—Marissa
Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
